einzeiler: Comedian Whitmer Thomas joins the show to discuss the Goo Goo Dolls anthem Iris.
kurzfassung: Host Yossi Salek and comedian Whitmer Thomas explore the making of the Goo Goo Dolls' 1998 hit song Iris. They discuss its origins for the film City of Angels, the intricate production choices by Rob Cavallo, and the band's punk rock beginnings in Buffalo. The conversation also touches on Whitmer's musical background, comedy specials, and shared pop culture nostalgia.
stichpunkte: Comedian Whitmer Thomas joins the podcast as a guest to break down the Goo Goo Dolls' iconic 1998 single Iris.
The song was explicitly written for the Nicolas Cage and Meg Ryan film City of Angels.
Producer Rob Cavallo played a massive role in shaping the demo into a massive, cinematic hit.
Johnny Resnick utilized a unique open tuning with broken guitar strings to create the song's signature lush, twelve-string sound.
Session guitarist Tim Pierce brought an extensive collection of gear to the studio, adding the track's memorable slide guitar solo.
The film's director initially wanted a completely different acoustic arrangement with ukuleles and bongos before settling on a twelve-string version for the movie.
The hosts trace the Goo Goo Dolls' trajectory from an underground Buffalo punk band called the Sex Maggots to mainstream success.
Whitmer shares personal memories of discovering the song in Alabama and discusses his own music projects and comedy specials.

clips.hook: Get the microphone away from me!
clips.text: The guest explains how his brother backed out of performing spoken parts and singing on stage due to intense last-minute stage fright.
The host praises a visionary producer who managed to recognize the immense potential hidden inside a rough demo recording.

clips.hook: Fifteen guitar amps, fifteen guitars, and like 100 pedals.
clips.text: A guest musician arrived at the recording studio equipped with an overwhelming amount of gear, much to the initial surprise of the band.
The conversation humorously spirals into existential dread about the absurdity of modern jobs and promotional media cycles.
The discussion turns to how an older track suddenly found a massive second life among younger audiences through short-form video platforms.

beschreibung:
Whitmer Thomas ('Terminal Crew of Dudes,' 'Weapons') joins Yasi to break down "Iris," the Goo Goo Dolls hit that became one of the defining songs of the late ’90s. They discuss the song’s origins on the 'City of Angels' soundtrack, the band’s punk beginnings, John Rzeznik’s singular and deeply inspiring (to Whitmer) hairstyle, and that iconic, rain-drenched performance of "Iris" in their hometown of Buffalo that somehow made a perfect song even more perfect.
